memories.content: CEO is the chief executive of Brightline. They have prepared a launch announcement post for the v4 release and intend to post it at the ship time. They want the announcement to gain traction and hope design partners will repost it.

Brightline is shipping its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday, 2026-09-15T10:00:00-07:00. The CEO plans to post a launch announcement on social media at that time. The three design partners are publicly known and have social media accounts where they can repost. The 24-hour window for the resolution ends at 2026-09-16T10:00:00-07:00.
